questions.q: How does the opening of Book Two echo the opening of Book One?
choices: It repeats the description of the lovely road from Ixopo into the hills — but now the view is from the tops, toward High Place
questions.explain: The perspective shifts from Kumalo's ruined valley to the rich farmland above it.

choices: James Jarvis's — it stands high above Ndotsheni
questions.explain: It is said to be 'one of the finest farms of this countryside.'

questions.q: Why does Jarvis watch the ploughing 'with a gloomy eye'?
choices: There is a drought — no rain, and the clods turn up 'hard and unbroken' over the iron soil
A fire has burned the fields

questions.q: What does Jarvis think about the eroded reserves below him, like Ndotsheni?
choices: That the land is fine and only needs rain
That it is 'a problem almost beyond solution' — the people are ignorant of farming methods and there are too many cattle
That the government should give the land back entirely
That it is not his concern
questions.explain: He turns 'these old thoughts' over as he climbs to the tops.

questions.q: Why did Jarvis's son not take over High Place?
choices: He went in for engineering instead, married and settled in Johannesburg
questions.explain: It had been 'a heavy blow' for Jarvis, but 'his life was his own.'

questions.q: Who brings the news to Jarvis on the hillside?
choices: Captain van Jaarsveld of the police, with Binnendyk
questions.explain: Van Jaarsveld is 'one of the most popular men in the village.'

choices: Jarvis's son Arthur was shot dead at 1.30 that afternoon in Johannesburg
questions.explain: 'It is suspected by a native housebreaker.'

questions.q: What help does the captain offer to get Jarvis to Johannesburg quickly?
choices: An aeroplane waiting at Pietermaritzburg — 'You could be in Johannesburg at midnight'
questions.explain: They must let the airport know by four o'clock.

questions.q: What weighs on Jarvis as he comes down the hill?
choices: That he must be the one to tell his wife Margaret, who 'isn't strong'
That the murderer may not be caught
questions.explain: 'I don't know how she will stand it.'

questions.q: How does Jarvis react when the captain asks if he can stand up?
choices: He sits without moving, dazed — 'Out of a cloudless sky these things come'
He refuses to move at all
questions.explain: His wife is watching from a distance and already senses something is wrong.
